qs.q: Which antithrombotic agent is administered to patients with STEMI following thrombolytics or PCI, with studies showing that low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) is superior to unfractionated heparin?
qs.e: IV heparin is used as an antithrombotic to prevent further thrombosis and aid in insuring patency of the occluded artery. LMWH is highlighted as being superior to unfractionated heparin in these studies.
